decision.explanation: The sources explicitly identify 'Fontbonne' as multiple distinct institutional types depending on the specific entity or time period referenced. D1S4 and D1S6 refer to 'Fontbonne Academy' (an academy/high school). D2S2 and D2S5 refer to 'Fontbonne University' (a university) and note it is one of the ministries founded by the congregation. D3S1 clarifies that 'Fontbonne College' was the name used when the academy referred to the high school, establishing 'college' as a valid historical type. While 'high school' is not explicitly used as a standalone noun phrase for the entity in the text, D3S1 states the academy 'solely referred to the high school,' making 'high school' a valid descriptive type for the institution at that time. Other candidates like 'military base', 'library', 'congregation', 'order', 'ministry', 'parochial school', 'campus', 'building', and 'school' are either locations, components, parent organizations, or generic terms not directly asserting the specific type of the named entity 'Fontbonne' in the same definitive manner as the accepted answers.
